name: cut-the-curve
description: A velocity-matched directional hard cut: the outgoing subject accelerates with power4.in, swaps at peak velocity, and the incoming subject continues in the same direction with power4.out.

vars.description: Visual payload used on both sides of the cut.
Shared screen direction for outgoing and incoming travel.
Normalized point where the hard cut swaps subjects.
Blur in pixels shared by both subjects at the cut seam.
Optional departure of the incoming subject. Default none: it rests until the frame cuts.
